idea: Medical and dental scrubs and clinic uniforms with logo embroidery (Turkish-made)
local_sellers: Mediclo (foreign Shopify store with an Albania storefront priced in lek), scrub top Lek 2,000 on sale (regular Lek 3,300), https://mediclo.com/en-al
ApparelnBags (US-based online, Tirana landing page, no lek price), https://www.apparelnbags.com/lp/medical-scrubs-coats-tirana-albania.htm
CityTex, Petrele/Tirana: local garment maker listing uniforms and workwear (no price), https://www.goafricaonline.com/al/directory/fashion-clothing-textiles
demand_evidence: 18,000+ Italian patients at Albanian dental clinics, +45% vs 2024, https://www.alfapress.al/english/ekonomi/italianet-shpenzuan-60-milione-euro-ne-klinikat-dentare-te-shqiperise-sh-i183879
109 dentistry clinics in Albania in one directory (commercial source), https://en.bookimed.com/clinics/country=albania/direction=dentistry
note: 4 searches (Albanian + English, shops, Instagram) found no local scrubs shop, only foreign webshops; but Albania has 875+ garment firms (PEA) that could sew them, so gap rated 'available'. Temu sells cheap scrubs; win on clinic-branded sets and re-orders. Merrjep could not be fetched (unverified). Not a medical device. Run 2 freshness check (2026-11-24): no new local seller found (search returned only ApparelnBags landing page / Fresha barbershops); score unchanged.

idea: Small-winery and home-winemaking equipment (Italian manual/electric presses, destemmer-crushers, stainless variable-capacity tanks)
buyer: B2B small wineries + B2C home winemakers
local_sellers: No Albanian winemaking-equipment shop found in 3 searches (Albanian, English, brand-dealer); only used presses located abroad on machineseeker.al, e.g. Della Toffola PE 12, https://www.machineseeker.al/della+toffola-pe+12/i-19738465
No Albanian dealer listed for Enoveneta or Grifo Marchetti (UK dealer Vigo Ltd only), https://vigoltd.com/pages/enoveneta
demand_evidence: Vineyard area from <3,000 ha (2010) to >10,500 ha; ~220,000 hl wine in 2024, https://www.enprimeurclub.com/guide/albanian-wine-producers-revive-native-grapes-near-tirana
70 registered wineries, 20+ major (Albania joined OIV 2023), https://www.vinetur.com/en/amp/2023090875175/albania-s-historic-milestone-entering-the-global-wine-stage-as-50th-oiv-member-state.html
Grape output 179,705 t in 2023 incl. 74,848 t from household pergolas (home winemaking), INSTAT, https://instat.gov.al/media/13517/agriculture-statistics-2023.pdf
note: Season Aug-Oct fills host kits' quiet months. Offline agro shops and hardware stores very likely sell basic presses (rule 7): phone-check before calling the gap real. Food-contact equipment only; avoid additives/chemicals. Electric crushers need CE. MFN 0% from WITS 2022 for 8435.10.
source: INSTAT agriculture statistics (grapes) + Albanian demand drivers (home winemaking)
